business_summary: santec Holdings Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells components and optical measuring instruments, and telecommunication systems. The company offers optical instruments, including tunable lasers, tunable filters, component testing, IL/RL meters, polarity testers, switches, optical power meters, attenuators, light sources, launch conditioning, inspection scopes, interferometers, and software; optical imaging and sensing products comprising precision wafer mappers, refined optical profilers, configurable OCT systems, lasers for swept-source OCT, and OEM components; and optical components that include spatial light modulators, spectral shaper power monitors, variable attenuators, optical filters, and optical submodules. It also provides quantum instruments, such as lasers, amplifiers, frequency conversions, electronics, and wavemeters, as well as medical devices comprising biometers. The company was formerly known as Santec Corporation and changed its name to santec Holdings Corporation in April 2023. santec Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Komaki, Japan.
